description: Holiday pay (New Zealand) [NZ]. Works out New Zealand holiday pay under the Holidays Act 2003: annual holidays (greater of ordinary weekly pay and average weekly earnings), 8% pay-as-you-go, public holiday pay (time and a half plus an alternative holiday if worked) and holiday pay on finishing a job. Doesn't handle sick or bereavement leave, variable-pay weeks, employer-specific agreements or the Employment Leave Act (due August 2028).

alreadyPaid.description: final_pay: holiday pay already paid in advance or as pay-as-you-go

entitledWeeksOwing.description: final_pay: weeks of annual holidays entitled to but not taken

gross.description: payg: gross pay for the period

grossEarnings12Months.description: annual, final_pay: gross earnings in the 12 months before the end of the last pay period

grossSinceAnniversary.description: final_pay: gross earnings since the last annual holidays anniversary date

ordinaryWeeklyPay.description: annual, final_pay: gross pay for a normal week, excluding bonuses and employer super

relevantDailyPay.description: public_holiday: what the employee would have earned for the day, including regular allowances

type.description: annual: pay for annual holidays taken; payg: 8% pay-as-you-go; public_holiday: pay for a public holiday; final_pay: holiday pay on finishing a job

weeksEmployed.description: annual, final_pay: weeks employed if under 52; defaults to 52

weeksTaken.description: annual: weeks of annual holidays taken; defaults to 4

worked.description: public_holiday: whether they worked the public holiday

name: nz_holiday_pay
